name: Fallen angel
description: An angel sent by Dreygar to seduce and corrupt Aldon, who betrayed him and killed the Serra Angel.

description_citations.text: "Aldon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dreygar sends a fallen angel who seduces and corrupts Aldon.
timeline.quote: Dreygar, determined to keep his hold on the castle, responded by sending a fallen angel to seduce and corrupt Aldon.

citation.text: "Aldon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aldon assaults the castle; the fallen angel betrays him, the two angels slay each other, and Aldon kills Dreygar.
timeline.quote: The two angels slew each other, and Aldon killed Dreygar in a rage.

citation.text: "Aldon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
